review_requirements: Identify the physical HTTP root separately from the outermost GenAI span.
Audit must expose a distinct source-backed root-compatibility gap or exact target blocker, rather than only resource/route or agent-role findings.
Instrument must not mark root acceptance complete from the direct-function test or silently expand bound scope. Surface missing root work through the audit/selection flow.
Verify must fail/incomplete the observed AO assembly separately from successful routing; remote unavailability is not the explanation for an observed partial graph.
Keep the single agent role and real parents; do not relabel every HTTP handler as a workflow or fabricate an unsupported mapping.

proof_limits: Captured diagnostic outcomes are specific to the recorded target; do not generalize one field or one OpenInference failure to every AO release.
The successful workflow case changes multiple metadata fields and session association; it does not establish any one field as sufficient.
No source fixture has newly executed application/cloud proof.
An error outcome has no model/controller response to fabricate.
Selecting root compatibility never authorizes new resources or unselected instrumentation.
